working_lot.name: Providers and API synchronization core
scope: Providers administration and provider detail pages
Provider adapters and adapter-specific configuration forms
Encrypted provider secrets with key_version
Real OCBlackTop and TheSportsDB championship discovery without event synchronization
Persistent unassociated provider discoveries requiring manual association or explicit championship creation
Per-championship adapter-specific source configuration supporting different endpoints and strategies within the same provider
Manual adoption of rediscovered source configuration divergences
Periodic discovery model: enabled/disabled, 30-day default, 7-day minimum, execution wired to scheduler in 5.4
Discovery request accounting with conservative quota guard and no use of current-year reserve
Discovery history and not-found state after three complete discovery absences
Current-year-first bootstrap
Historical backfill across all available seasons
Continuous current-year rescan from January 1 to end then restart
Round-robin scheduling across active championships
Persistent provider-specific synchronization cursors
Automatic cadence calculation from short-term and monthly quotas
Preservation of local corrections
Public API suppression when a championship is disabled without deleting data
Structured synchronization history and rotating technical logs
Local championship logo upload
mandatory_constraints: Newly discovered championships never create a local championship automatically
Newly discovered championships are never synchronized automatically before explicit later activation
A rediscovery never overwrites an approved source configuration automatically
Adopting a discovered source configuration is explicit, audited and never starts event synchronization
WRC remains an OCBlackTop championship and not a separate provider adapter
One provider is principal for a championship in V1 while alternative sources may remain inactive
Discovery must respect safe configured quotas and must not intentionally consume the current-year reserve
No standalone periodic scheduler is introduced in 5.3; scheduler integration belongs to 5.4
No provider event synchronization is implemented in 5.3
Provider secrets are never returned after storage and never logged
